compiled.draft: Operators shall accept protected sender IDs only when authenticated by the registered sender, and authenticated essential senders shall bypass content filtering.
compiled.rationale: The provision requires sender authentication and specifies that authenticated essential senders bypass content filtering, which aligns with the provided mechanisms.
